derivation.rule: A file f is gold-affected for target iff, among commits (first-parent history up to the pinned commit) that touched target, f co-occurs in at least minCoChanges commits AND co-occurs in at least minSupport of them (coChanges(f) / commitsWithTarget). Both defaults below. See goldAffectedSet's doc comment in src/metrics/gold.ts for the full rule.
derivation.history_window: git log --first-parent (linear ancestry of the pinned commit, full repo history)
